name: Netorare Hime
source: Hime is descendant of Elf royal family and will soon become head of clan. In order to succeed the throne, she has to overcome a trial which requires her to live alone in a separated place for one month. After leaving her fiancé Eru behind to fulfil the duty, she wakes up at a house in human world and meets a strange man who would change her life forever.
